### D1.1 Project KPIs — attainment against target
**⚠ SIMULATED DATA.** No real KIO module reports these yet; every value below is generated by `kio-simulator/kio_simulator.py` within D1.1's baseline/target bands. These are *not* project results. Real values will arrive tagged `source=real` as KIO owners connect.

panels.title: Attainment — 100% means the D1.1 target is met (all KIOs, SIMULATED)
panels.description:
Each KPI is normalised against its own D1.1 target so one axis covers all of them:

- lower-is-better KPIs: `100 x target / measured`
- higher-is-better KPIs: `100 x measured / target`

Green = target met or beaten (>=100%), amber = within 20% of it, red = below, grey = no KIO currently reporting it.

D1.1 states almost every KPI as a percentage of baseline (baseline = 100%), and the simulator emits them in that unit — so no unit conversion or baseline midpoint is assumed anywhere. Averaged over the dashboard time range.

targets.legendFormat: KPI 1.1 Code generation speed  (target ≤70% of baseline (≈70–90 min))
KPI 1.2 Issue resolution speed  (target ≤70% of baseline (≈0.7 days))
KPI 2.1 Lifecycle energy reduction  (target ≤85% of baseline (≥15% reduction))
KPI 2.2 Deployment energy efficiency  (target ≥115% of baseline (≥15% improvement))
KPI 3.1 Code quality improvement  (target ≤70% of the adverse-quality measure (≥30% improvement))
KPI 3.2 Review score increase  (target ≥120% of baseline (≈4.2 / 5))
KPI 4.1 Developer productivity  (target ≥120% of baseline (≈1.20 features / developer / day))
KPI 6.1 Bug-fix time  (target ≤80% of baseline (≈7–10 hours))
KPI 6.2 Customer-reported issues  (target ≤80% of baseline (≈4 issues / feature))
KPI 7.1 Annual cost  (target ≤85% of baseline (≈EUR 85 000 / year))
KPI 8.1 Adoption rate  (target ≥50% of active developers within two pilot sprints)
KPI 8.2 Active usage  (target ≥60% of developers using a feature at least once per sprint)
KPI 8.3 Cross-architecture build success  (target ≥1 validated working target)
KPI 9.1 Refactoring reduction  (target ≤80% of baseline (≈1.5–2 h / feature))
KPI 9.2 Technical debt reduction  (target ≤80% of baseline (≈0.8 h / 100 LOC))

panels.title: Measured value in D1.1's own unit (all KIOs, SIMULATED)
panels.description: The raw measurement behind each attainment bar, in the unit D1.1 specifies — percent of baseline for all but KPI 8.1 (% of eligible users), 8.2 (% of users, and MOS 1-5) and 8.3 (a count). Each bar is coloured against that KPI's own target, so green here means the same thing as green above.

targets.expr: count(count by (kio_id) (increase(kio_heartbeat[5m]) > bool 0 == 1)) or count(count by (kio_id)(kio_heartbeat))

panels.title: Total LLM cost (USD)
panels.description: Cumulative total since process start (not a rate) — it keeps growing, so a green/yellow/red health threshold isn't meaningful; deliberately left neutral (blue).

panels.title: Energy (kJ, all)
panels.description: Cumulative total since process start (not a rate) — it keeps growing, so a green/yellow/red health threshold isn't meaningful; deliberately left neutral (blue).

panels.title: Time since last heartbeat (seconds)
panels.description: Every KIO must publish a heartbeat every 60s (Contract §2.3). Values exceeding 120s (2x the interval) turn red — see the 'Stale KIO' alert rule in grafana/provisioning/alerting/rules.yml, which fires on the same threshold in the Alerting tab.
